note: What a server sends to say where a missile is and what it is doing.

fields.name: atX
fields.note: Where the missile is, along one ground axis.

fields.name: atY
fields.note: Where the missile is, in height.

fields.name: atZ
fields.note: Where the missile is, along the other ground axis.

fields.name: casterAtX
fields.note: Where the unit that threw it stood when it left, along one ground axis.

fields.name: casterAtY
fields.note: Where the unit that threw it stood when it left, in height.

fields.name: casterAtZ
fields.note: Where the unit that threw it stood when it left, along the other ground axis.

fields.name: facingX
fields.note: Which way the missile points, along one ground axis.

fields.name: facingY
fields.note: Which way the missile points, in height.

fields.name: facingZ
fields.note: Which way the missile points, along the other ground axis.

fields.name: velocityX
fields.note: How fast the missile travels along each axis, along one ground axis.

fields.name: velocityY
fields.note: How fast the missile travels along each axis, in height.

fields.name: velocityZ
fields.note: How fast the missile travels along each axis, along the other ground axis.

fields.name: startX
fields.note: Where the missile began, along one ground axis.

fields.name: startY
fields.note: Where the missile began, in height.

fields.name: startZ
fields.note: Where the missile began, along the other ground axis.

fields.name: endX
fields.note: Where the missile is bound for, along one ground axis.

fields.name: endY
fields.note: Where the missile is bound for, in height.

fields.name: endZ
fields.note: Where the missile is bound for, along the other ground axis.

fields.name: unitAtX
fields.note: Where the unit the missile follows stands, along one ground axis.

fields.name: unitAtY
fields.note: Where the unit the missile follows stands, in height.

fields.name: unitAtZ
fields.note: Where the unit the missile follows stands, along the other ground axis.

fields.name: age
fields.note: How long the missile has existed, in seconds.

fields.name: speed
fields.note: How fast it travels.

fields.name: lifeSpent
fields.note: How much of its life is gone, as a part of one.

fields.name: speedChange
fields.note: What is added to its speed over the time below.

fields.name: speedChangeTime
fields.note: How long that change takes, in seconds.

bits.name: bounced
bits.note: Set where the missile has already turned off something it struck.

bits.name: unknown
bits.note: Purpose undetermined. A server leaves these as it found them, so they carry values it never wrote for this message.

fields.name: cast
fields.note: The casting that threw it.
